_comment: Rank changes what an Inscription can DO, not how large its numbers are. Effect magnitude rises only gently with rank (rank_scale); each rank's real gain is its unlock, which the resolver checks by id.

ranks.title: Awakened
ranks.unlock_text: Your Inscription can be used at all.

ranks.title: Ascendant
ranks.unlock_text: Two applications can be brought to bear in one encounter instead of one.

ranks.title: Exalted
ranks.unlock_text: Your condition can be satisfied by an ally who meets it on your behalf.

ranks.title: Sovereign
ranks.state: The individual begins influencing their surroundings through their Law.
ranks.unlock_text: Your principle colours the space around you without being invoked.

ranks.title: Transcendent
ranks.unlock_text: You may choose which price you pay, once a day.

ranks.title: Eternal
ranks.state: A being approaching the fundamental Laws themselves.
ranks.unlock_text: Not recorded. Nobody who reached it has been asked.

failure_consequences.text: Your Inscription goes silent. It will not answer for {days} days.
Your Inscription answers wrongly for a while: every use costs twice.
{application} closes to you. You will have to find it again.
The trial leaves a mark that does not fade. People who know what it means will look twice.
